title: Tech View offers no pin control while Assigned to me is on
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards" and yourself (Clockable on, enrolled here)). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 led by you, S1-691 led by Ralph Edwards):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. Check the pin control shows on the group headers.
  5. Turn on Assigned to me.
  6. Look at the headers of every group still shown.
  7. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  8. Look at the column headers.
  9. Turn Assigned to me off.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With Assigned to me off, group headers show a pin control.
  • With Assigned to me on, no group header in Tech View offers a pin control, the same as Board View.
  • Turning Assigned to me off brings the pin controls back.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-N4, S3-N3, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD footer comment Slavcho Mitrov 2 Oct 2026 item 3, folded into the 7 Oct PRD.
